outcome: cord blood levels of free triiodothyronine (FT3)
cord blood levels of free thyroxine (FT4)
cord blood levels of thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH)
cohort: 922 mother-newborn pairs from a prospective birth cohort enrolled in 2012-2013 in Shanghai, China
finding: Newborns born via cesarean section had higher cord serum FT3 and lower TSH than those born via vaginal delivery, and advanced maternal age was associated with lower fetal FT3.
mod_finding: Newborns born via cesarean section had higher cord serum FT3 and lower TSH than those born via vaginal delivery.
